info.name: Adobe Captivate Prime API (Learning Manager) Account Enrollments API

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The offset for pagination (number of records to skip)

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (max 10)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field and direction. Prefix with - for descending order. Example: -dateCreated, name, -dateUpdated

params.name: filter.loInstanceId
params.description: Filter by learning object instance ID

params.name: filter.states
params.description: Comma-separated list of enrollment states to filter by

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Valid values: learningObject, loInstance, loResourceGrades

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of enrollments. Can be scoped to the authenticated user or to all users (admin only). Supports filtering by learning object ID, state, and date range.
Enrolls a user in a learning object instance. The request must specify the learning object instance and the user to enroll.

params.name: enrollmentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the enrollment

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include

items.docs: Retrieves a single enrollment by its ID.

params.name: enrollmentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the enrollment

items.docs: Removes a user's enrollment from a learning object instance. Only applicable if the enrollment is in a state that allows unenrollment.
